text:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Release v3.8.0 promoted to prod. Canary -> 30%. Telemetry: elevated 5xx rate in embeddings-service (prod) starting 18:07 UTC. Auto-rollback not triggered. Please triage: https://ci/release/5234

alex: I'm seeing the same in dashboards — p95 up ~3x and error-rate spike correlates with kernel/kv changes. @priya can you check node health and KV eviction logs? @mike FYI this is hitting eu-west-1 Dedicated pools.

priya: looking. initial grep shows frequent `kv_eviction` logs after roll. Pulling debug from instance-023.

mike: product — flagged to CS. Dedicated customers might be sensitive to tail latency. If this persists we should rollback dedicated first.

jordan: talked to the customer on eu-west-1, they're seeing timeouts on some embedding calls. They asked if we can revert.

alex: quick options: 1) manual rollback to v3.7.4 (safe) 2) pin traffic to older model variant + keep investigating 3) attempt KV hotfix patch (risky during rollout). We have ~20m left in the change window. Thoughts?

priya: hotfix is nontrivial (kernel tweak). If p95 stays >300ms for >10m, recommend rollback. I can run rollback from runbook.

mike: agree with priya. For customer trust, manual rollback asap for Dedicated, hold Hosted until metrics stable.

ajex: (typo) sorry ignore

alex: sorry, typo above. Confirming: manual rollback consensus. @deploy-bot pause rollout and pin to v3.7.4 for prod. @sara please prep release notes update and customer comms.

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout now. Command queued: `redwood release pause --release v3.8.0 --scope prod`

priya: Running rollback runbook step 1->3 now. Command I will run: ```bash
# rollback to stable
redwood release rollback --to v3.7.4 --scope prod --confirm
```
Estimated time ~6m, will drain connections gracefully.

sara: Drafting customer message: "We've reverted the recent deployment (v3.8.0) due to elevated latency for embedding requests in some regions. We have rolled back to v3.7.4 and are investigating root cause; will follow up with an RCA and ETA for a safe re-deploy." Will post to #customer-briefing after rollback completes and send the template email.

jordan: I'll keep the customer updated and share the rollback ETA.

priya: rollback started -> running promote from v3.7.4 into prod. Running health checks.

priya: rollback complete. Metrics: p95 and 5xx back to baseline on eu-west-1. No new error spikes seen.

deploy-bot: Rollback to v3.7.4 completed at 18:34 UTC. Canary restored to normal percentages. Notifying on-call and #eng-releases.

alex: great work. Follow-ups: create postmortem, add a merge-block on the kernel change (PR #7891), and schedule a canary replay with extra KV diagnostics. I'll open the ticket.

sara: Posted the customer note to #customer-briefing and queued the email. Draft link: https://docs.internal/drafts/rollback-v3.8.0

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: confirming customer acknowledged and appreciates quick revert.

alex: thanks team — closing this thread. We'll pick up RCA tomorrow during the postmortem.
